questions.prompt: A triangle has angles 45°, 75° and x. Find x.
An exterior angle of a triangle is 130°. One interior opposite angle is 70°. Find the other.
questions.explain: Exterior angle = sum of the interior opposite angles: 130 − 70 = 60.

questions.prompt: Can lengths 5 cm, 7 cm and 13 cm make a triangle?
questions.explain: The two shorter sides must add to more than the longest.

questions.prompt: A triangle has angles 30°, 60° and 90°. What type is it?
An isosceles triangle has a top (vertex) angle of 40°. What is each base angle?
Why do the angles of every triangle add to 180°?
options: A line through one corner, parallel to the opposite side, makes alternate angles that together form a straight line
questions.explain: The three angles fit together along a straight line.

questions.prompt: A roof truss is an isosceles triangle with base angles of 35°. What is the angle at the top?
Two sides of a triangle are 4 cm and 9 cm. The third side must be…
options: more than 5 cm and less than 13 cm
